ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the “atmosphere's heat-preservation effect on the ground,” containing text boxes such as “radiated toward outer space,” “atmospheric absorption,” “ground absorption,” and “ground radiation,” as well as multiple numbered arrows. It can be seen that the incident arrow entering from the direction of the sun or outer space, reaching the ground downward, and related to “ground absorption” is labeled 4. Then reason: Solar radiation belongs to the incoming shortwave radiation from the sun and directed toward the ground from outside the atmosphere, so it corresponds to the arrow that reaches the ground downward in the figure. The numerical code of this arrow is 4.
